description: This file contains internal font helper functions for the PdfSharp .NET library, including methods for measuring strings, creating typefaces, font creation for GDI and WPF, checksum calculation, and glyph counting. It is part of the internal font processing subsystem.

classes.name: FontHelper
classes.description: A static class providing internal font utility functions for measurement, creation, and analysis within the PdfSharp library.

methods.name: MeasureString
methods.description: Measures the size of a string given font data, with a note that it is a placeholder and that a newer version replaces it.

methods.name: MeasureString
methods.description: Measures a string from a code point glyph pair array and font descriptor, calculating width and height, and adjusting for bold simulation.

methods.name: CreateTypeface
methods.description: Creates a WPF typeface from a font family and style.

methods.name: CreateFont
methods.description: Creates a GDI font from a family name, size, and style, and outputs associated font source.

methods.name: CalcChecksum
methods.description: Calculates an Adler32 checksum combined with buffer length into a 64-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: CreateStyle
methods.description: Creates an XFontStyleEx value based on bold and italic boolean flags.

methods.name: CountGlyphs
methods.description: Counts the number of glyphs in a font by iterating over Unicode code points and checking for glyph index existence.
